content.short: Music creators & listeners will have opportunities to earn money from audio streams and compete with other demons in games to earn money.
content.description:
Demon City Audio Streaming is the world’s first audio streaming platform on the Cardano network, that not only will artist and producers be a to receive royalties in $DEMON tokens, the listeners will also be rewarded. Demons have the opportunity to promote there music on the front page using $DEMON token promotions. cNFT holders will be able to use their art as their profile picture proving authenticity. cNFT holders will also begiven promotional opportunities. The goal with Demon City Audio Streaming is to give demons opportunities to earn rewards not only as a creator but a listener.

Demon City gaming will consist of a series of mini games leading up to the release of Demon City. Demons will be given the opportunity to earn money by competing with other demons and be rewarded in $DEMON tokens. Demon City will be a Meta Verse with gameplay similar to GTA where Demon will be rewarded for killing other demons, completing missions, and will incentivize demons to form gangs and alliances for protection. Demons will be able to stream music from Demon City Audio Streaming by driving cars and speakers located in the game. Demon City will host concerts provided by our Demon City Audio Streaming platform with VIP sections for our cNFT holders.
